_comment: INDUSTRIAL: three spare hull plates stacked flat and lashed down with two dark straps - the builders carry their materials, and a laydown yard on deck says the next repair is already planned. The plates are ALMOST square to each other, two to four degrees out: a working yard stacks straight and a scrapyard does not, so the jitter stays a fraction of what the salvage kit authors. The straps run past the plate edges so they read as wrapped over the stack, not painted on it. NO yellow - lashings are shadow, and the accent stays on edges, collars and handles. Long axis is +Z so `align: Run` lies the stock with the deck grain.
